QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Kurama's Fear
QuestInfo.0: You gain the respect of the Fox Yokai and even a Human child on Kurama's behalf. Perhaps Kurama will finally be willing to end his time as a hermit.
QuestInfo.1: It turns out Kurama doesn't care about the respect of others. Perhaps there's only one specific person whose feelings he cares about?
QuestInfo.2: It seems Kurama became a hermit out of fear he might accidentally hurt someone. Help Kurama contain his power to put his mind at ease.
